prompt: What is a code cell in a notebook used for?
promptHi: Notebook mein code cell kis kaam aata hai?
optionsHi: Code likhne aur run karne ke liye
Sirf photos store karne ke liye
Laptop battery change karne ke liye
whyEn: A code cell holds Python statements that you can execute.
whyHi: Code cell mein Python statements likhte hain aur execute karte hain.

prompt: Where does a notebook usually show a cell’s output?
promptHi: Notebook aam taur par cell ka output kahan dikhata hai?
whyEn: The result is displayed under the cell that ran it.
whyHi: Jis cell ko run kiya uska result aam taur par uske neeche dikhta hai.

prompt: Which shortcut commonly runs a Google Colab cell?
promptHi: Google Colab cell run karne ka common shortcut kya hai?
whyEn: Shift + Enter runs the selected Colab cell and moves to the next one.
whyHi: Shift + Enter selected Colab cell run karta hai aur next cell par le ja sakta hai.

prompt: Why can running notebook cells out of order cause confusion?
promptHi: Notebook cells out of order run karne se confusion kyun ho sakta hai?
options: A variable may not have been created yet
The notebook turns into a PDF
optionsHi: Variable abhi create hi nahi hua ho sakta hai
Python numbers support karna band kar deta hai
Saare comments gayab ho jaate hain
whyEn: A later cell may depend on a variable created by an earlier cell.
whyHi: Later cell kisi aise variable par depend kar sakta hai jo earlier cell mein create hua tha.

prompt: Can the same basic Python statement run in Colab and a local .py file?
promptHi: Kya same basic Python statement Colab aur local .py file dono mein run ho sakta hai?
options: Only if it contains a picture
Only on one particular brand of laptop
optionsHi: Nahi, Python syntax poori change ho jaati hai
whyEn: The Python language is the same; the way you launch and manage the environment differs.
whyHi: Python language same hai; environment launch/manage karne ka tareeka alag hota hai.
